thesis: Hold the September 29 event-driven reset. VRTX and NEM remain pre-event positions rather than tape-following trades: Vertex's November 30 povetacicept PDUFA is the core binary catalyst, while Newmont's confirmed October 22 results are 13 trading sessions away. The October 2 whole-universe screen was dominated by extended semiconductor and software moves: SOXL gained 53.4% over 20 sessions, AMD 39.0%, MRVL 30.4%, INTC 30.2%, and DDOG 29.1%, with RSI readings of 72–90. Robinhood fundamentals show VRTX at 29.364401x trailing earnings and NEM at 14.592199x, while the paper book still trails SPY by 17.9 points with a -3.75 Sharpe. No new momentum exposure is justified; retain 64% cash and keep weights capped. This is the project's paper-portfolio bridge, not an official plugin investment recommendation.

evidence.point: The Federal Reserve’s 2026 calendar lists the next FOMC meeting for October 27–28, with a press conference on October 28.
Vertex says FDA assigned a November 30, 2026 PDUFA target date; the RAINIER interim analysis showed a 52.0% UPCR reduction from baseline and a 49.8% reduction versus placebo (P<0.0001).
Vertex reported Q2 2026 revenue of $3.33 billion, up 12% year over year, and raised full-year revenue guidance to $13.1–$13.2 billion.
Newmont says it will release Q3 2026 results after market close on October 22, followed by a 5:30 p.m. EDT conference call.
Newmont reported Q2 2026 production of about 1.3 million attributable gold ounces and record Q2 free cash flow of $2.2 billion while maintaining full-year guidance.
At the October 2 settled close, VRTX was $504.73 and NEM $115.56. Robinhood reported VRTX P/E 29.364401 and Q2 net margin 32.99%; NEM P/E 14.592199 and Q2 net margin 35.99%.

risks: VRTX faces a binary November 30 FDA decision; a delay, rejection, restrictive label, or adverse safety interpretation breaks the thesis.
NEM is down 11.40% over 20 sessions and 9.4% from the paper entry; gold-price reversal, cost inflation, or weak Q3 execution can overwhelm the valuation case.
A 64% cash balance creates substantial opportunity cost if risk assets continue higher.
The portfolio has produced -17.9 points of all-time alpha with a -3.75 annualized Sharpe; confidence stays low until realized results improve.

worked: The September 29 reset again prevented a chase into screen leaders whose 20-session moves now range from roughly 29% to 53%.
